_doc: THE LAST LIGHT campaign (Stage 3B layout 2: STAGE3_NARRATIVE_MASTER.md §7). Beats run in order; 'when' is a StoryState expression (flag(), has_flag(), clue(), saved(), lost(), piloting(), lit_by_hand(), relation(), sim.*). 'hint' is [seconds, text] or a list of them. Director actions: talk, wait, until <expr>, release <ship> (a holding story ship makes way), objective, set/unset/add/clue, ship, storm, clock, fault (jam [story] | trip | overheat), battery, mode, intensity, autosave, timeskip, ending_card, end_campaign; presentation events for game_fp: hint, sky, phantom_echo, footsteps, knock, door_open, visitor_enter, sfx, static, music, caption. story_test rejects unknown names. 'optional_calls' are radio calls offered in the panel after beat open_after has run and until beat close_at has run; 'needs_power' (brief item 32) marks a beat that can only move on with power (radio or light): while it waits unpowered the director shows what to fix. 'story_voice' lists ships whose 'we have the channel lights' report a story conversation speaks itself (item 26). 'after_read' maps a document to [first chapter, last chapter, conversation] room lines played once each.

beats.objective: Lighting-up time: MODE to AUTO and LAMP to NORMAL at the light console under the east window.  ({move} to walk, {look} to look.)
hint: The light console stands under the east window. Look at the MODE knob and press {interact}.

beats.objective: The batteries are tired. Start the generator in the cage (south-west): open the FUEL VALVE, then hold START.
hint: In the cage: the red FUEL VALVE handle first, then hold {interact} on the black START button until the engine catches.

beats.objective: Switch CHARGE on at the charger (west wall).
hint: The CHARGE lever is on the charger cabinet, below the small meter.
Sit at the radio on the desk (look at it, press {interact}), select Kittiwake and choose Confirm position.
do: Use the radio (desk): select Kittiwake and ask her to CONFIRM POSITION.

beats.objective: Turn Kittiwake onto the North Sound leading line (000°) until she reports the channel.
hint: On the radar she sits to the right of the dashed 000° line. Order TURN PORT once or twice, then MAINTAIN when she points down the line.

beats.objective: Write up the evening in the station log (desk).
hint: The logbook lies open on the desk, left of the chart.

beats.objective: Watch the radar for the caller.
Bring Gannet in through the West Gut (314°).
hint: Confirm Gannet's position, then turn her until she points down the West Gut line on the radar.

beats.objective: Find the 1953 station log in the old-log box (storage shelf, left of the stair door).
hint: The old station logs are in the oak box on the top storage shelf, left of the stair door.

beats.objective: Free the gear by hand: MODE to OFF, turn the handwheel back past 046°, then MODE to AUTO.
hint: At the light console: {turn_back} on the MODE knob turns it back to OFF. With the motor off, {wheel} on the handwheel turns the optic by hand. Then MODE to AUTO.

optional_calls.label: Call Gannet (Hector, in the West Gut lee)

beats.objective: Bring Corrie May and Lowestoft Star in. Mind the battery.
beats.when: (saved("Corrie May") or lost("Corrie May")) and (saved("Lowestoft Star") or lost("Lowestoft Star"))
hint: Corrie May belongs in the East Gut (046°), Lowestoft Star in the North Sound (000°). Confirm each, then turn them onto the lines.

beats.objective: Restore power: reset the MAIN breaker (distribution cabinet, west wall).
hint: In the dark: the red MAIN lamp on the tall cabinet. Push the MAIN lever up ({interact}).

optional_calls.label: Call Stornoway on the MF set (2182 kHz)

beats.objective: Identify the dark boat: switch to MANUAL and hold the beam on her with the handwheel.
hint: MODE to MANUAL, then at the console hold {wheel} on the handwheel until the beam sits on her (the radar shows the beam line).

beats.objective: She will not answer. Watch her come in.

do: [A cough, deep in the chest. It goes on a long time.]
[Footsteps on the stair. One step at a time.]

hint: The stair door is on the south wall.
The bottom-left drawer of the desk.

beats.objective: Get the light back: reset MAIN and keep the generator alive.
hint: MAIN breaker on the west wall. If the generator has cut out hot, let it cool, then restart it.

beats.objective: Free the gear by hand: MODE to OFF, back the handwheel past 046°, then MODE to MANUAL.
hint: At the light console: {turn_back} on the MODE knob to OFF, {wheel} on the handwheel to back the optic off the tooth, then MODE to MANUAL.

beats.objective: Hold the light on Iona Star and talk her into the East Gut (046°).
hint: MANUAL mode puts a long beam on her so she can see. Confirm her position, then turn her onto the 046° line.
